How is security handled in Universe OS?

Layered by design: GUI sudo gate (universe-privilege) with deny-by-default, hardened sysctls (/etc/sysctl.d/99-universe.conf: kptr_restrict=2, unprivileged_bpf_disabled=1, yama ptrace_scope=1, kexec_load_disabled=1…), mandatory AppArmor (module.sig_enforce=1), UFW deny-incoming, Flatpak sandbox hardening, and BTRFS+snapper snapshots.

What is gate-exec?

gate-exec is the ONLY custom setuid-root binary in Universe OS (a small C program). Approved jobs are deposited as single-use tokens into a root-only directory (0700) and executed by gate-exec with an env allowlist — closing the classic sudo-real bypass.

Both in universe-settings and the welcome wizard, Wi-Fi passwords are passed via stdin or 0600 NetworkManager keyfiles — never on the command line (no /proc snooping).
